title: S5 visible authoring demonstration: receipt
gate_row: Existing inspector/viewer shows mechanism, active representation, scale and measurements | Physical/render/pick correspondence; repeatable build-test-reuse demonstration; human usability remains separately observed

browser_path.endpoint_glass: GET /glass - the composited window: viewport + the Studio overlay, as the operator sees it (main.cpp:3066)
browser_path.board_feed: the engine's own studio board file (main.cpp:975, ui.cpp poll_board) fed by the harness with LIVE measured values; no web page authored, no engine edit

frame_identity_across_runs.law: prereg repeatability: /frame of states A, B, C byte-identical across the two runs

readout_identity.law: board text (the on-screen readout) and measured engine values digit-for-digit identical across runs

glass_dynamic_pixels.law: the glass carries the status bar's fps/ms, the timeline/show clocks and the reel's grab stamps, which tick; the changed-pixel set is RECORDED (prereg: not required zero) and must stay confined to the chrome bands (strip y<90, right dock x>1400, reel/timeline/status y>780)

shows_mechanism.evidence: glass envelope + strip chip + status bar: 'mechanism: assembly.star-k2 (k=2 fan-out star, 601 vertices / 600 faces)' with the record's own law id and revision (a2/b2/c2/d1/e1 PNGs); identity chain: record port star-input-seam-apex = MD01 centre vertex 200

shows_active_representation.evidence: states A-C: 'active representation: DETAILED SOLVE (fused mesh, patch-equilibrium-solver-v2)'; state D switches on screen to 'REDUCED TABLE (S3) - NO solve, table lookup only' with the S4 switching bound evaluated live (d1 PNG)

shows_scale.evidence: 'scale s = 1.0 (record window [0.75, 2.0])' in every envelope; r0 = 1 wu, gamma = 1.0 J/wu^2 named in the reuse rows

shows_measurements.evidence: LIVE numbers from GET /membrane_demo on screen: apex z, free residual, energy, accepted_state_id per state; reuse rows show table-vs-engine diffs 1.70e-07 wu (0.8 N) and 7.04e-07 wu (1.6 N) against bound 1e-6

physical_render_pick_correspondence.evidence: the deform control's ONLY free DOF is the packet-declared centre (engine.cpp md_deform) = record load port vertex 200 (seam apex); the engine's /project (same VP the mesh pass used, present-stage mapping (x, z+lift, -y), lift 0.5) places the apex at px (960, 426.9) INSIDE the A-vs-B render diff bbox {'x0': 862, 'x1': 1052, 'y0': 405, 'y1': 456} (1218 px changed around the seam); physical: the measured apex z matches the S3/study seam-apex equilibria (diffs 1.70e-07 / 7.04e-07 wu)

repeatable_build_test_reuse.evidence: two full runs: BUILD (compile+upload) -> TEST (0.8 N, 1.6 N deform) -> REUSE (S3 table, no engine call) executed twice; /frame byte-identical across runs for A, B, C; board readout text and measured values digit-for-digit identical; run records s5_authoring_demo/run1,run2/run_record.json

human_usability.verdict: OUT OF SCOPE (the gate column says 'separately observed'; not chased here)

retained_failures.analysis: the engine's deform commits the best-|fz-W| candidate under GPU-kernel f32 evaluation (engine.cpp md_deform), so the landing may exceed the bisection bracket width; the LAW-level bounds PASS: free residual 1.4e-07 N <= 1e-6 N, apex in the frozen band, and the S4 switching round-trip bound 1e-6 wu (7.04e-07). The increment-5 force allowance is 1e-4 N (= 1.4e-05 wu at dfz/dz ~ 7.3 N/wu), which the landing satisfies with large margin. Retained, not silently widened.

retained_failures.predicate: prereg pick projection assumed demo coords == render world coords
retained_failures.correction: the engine's own present stage maps demo (x,y,z) to render world (x, z+lift, -y) (membrane_demo.comp:150, the recorded B2 z-up -> engine y-up presentation; lift rides the MD01 header = 0.5). The corrected projection PASSES the preregistered containment check; the prereg target (vertex 200, the seam apex) is unchanged

scope: existing inspector/viewer demonstration only; no engine edit, no record edit, no GPU batch, no inference; human usability separately observed per the gate column
